description: Chess move legality, SAN/UCI conversion and next FEN — Checks whether a move (or a sequence of moves) is legal from a FEN position under the FIDE Laws of Chess, for agents that play, annotate or verify chess games. Accepts UCI or SAN, returns the normalized move, the new FEN, check / checkmate / stalemate / insufficient-material flags and, if asked, every legal move; an illegal move names the reason (castling_through_check, ep_exposes_king, moves_into

items.description: 1 to 50 positions, at most 400 moves in total.

expectFen.description: Optional claim: the FEN you expect after the move(s). Compared on placement, side, castling and capturable en passant (4 or 6 fields).

list.description: Also return every legal move (UCI and SAN) in the final position. At most 20 items per call.

move.description: One move to check from the position, UCI (e2e4, e7e8q, e1g1) or SAN (Nf3, exd5, e8=Q, O-O).

moves.description: Moves played one after another from the position; stops at the first that is not legal. Use either move or moves.

name: chess-move
